items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Joe Garland's going to take over the band... I learned my lesson from the Blue Rhythm Band... So anyway, Joe Garland, he was the boss from then on.

ctx.x: Jobetus' place. And shortly after I went in the band, then Cass, he quit the band, too, and Joe Garland taken Cass McCord's place. Then they started
